items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...didn't get a chance to get to the great teachers... From your father, is that right? Who set that up for you? [INTERVIEWEE] My grandfather.

ctx.x: because of money or just depending on where they lived and everything like that. You understand, that they were unable to get to an A-1 teacher. From your father, is that right? Who set that up for you?
Your grandfather. Because, like I said, a lot of them didn't have money (inaudible) musicians, they just had to get up as they would go.
